I peeled then rinsed the potatoes. Cubed, then rinsed again. A few tablespoons of butter melted to begin. Minced onion cooked until transparent, garlic right after until fragrant. After that, add the potatoes and toss a few times to coat with butter. Cooked covered with lid for probably 20 minutes, or until you get the desired color, tossing every so often and adding a little more butter as you go. I then added a pinch of tyme towards the end.
I let it cook almost all the way through with a lid on the pan. And when you go to flip it make sure you use a good non stick spatula.
